final_message:
The bug was in `session_ttl.py:10`: `now` was parsed and then had its tzinfo stripped with `.replace(tzinfo=None)` while `created` kept its timezone, so subtracting an aware `created` from a naive `now` raised `TypeError`. I removed the `.replace(tzinfo=None)` so both timestamps are parsed symmetrically; aware inputs (including offset-shifted ones) and naive inputs both compare correctly now. `format_expiry_message` is untouched. Public test passes (1/1).

DONE: Removed the asymmetric tzinfo strip on `now` in session_ttl_expired so aware ISO timestamps compare correctly; test_public passes.

turns.final_message:
Rewrote `t1-repair_merge_intervals/solution.py`: validates `intervals` is a list (TypeError otherwise), each item is a 2-element list/tuple of plain non-bool ints with `start <= end` (ValueError otherwise), then sorts copies by start and merges touching/overlapping intervals into new `[start, end]` lists without mutating the input. Public tests pass (2/2), and spot checks confirmed empty input, non-mutation, touching-merge, and all rejection cases.

DONE: Repaired merge_intervals with input validation, sort-and-merge logic, and no input mutation; `python3 -m unittest -v test_public.py` passes 2/2.

Trace: `base_fee(1000)` = 500 + 1000 // 10 = 600; `apply_discount(600, "gold")` = 600 − (600 × 20) // 100 = 600 − 120 = 480. The decoy modules (`decoy_tax.py`, `decoy_shipping.py`) are not imported by `service2.py`.

ANSWER: 480

Added an empty check to `dequeue` in `t3-edit_dequeue_validation/queue_util.py`: it now raises `ValueError('queue is empty')` when `items` is empty, and otherwise still pops and returns the first element. Verified both paths manually. (The only lint note was a quote-style formatting preference; I kept the single quotes to match the README's exact message spelling.)

DONE: dequeue() now raises ValueError('queue is empty') on empty input; non-empty behavior unchanged.
